signals_info.description: Indicates whether the target-side blind spot is occupied; 0 means unoccupied and 1 means occupied.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the target-side blind spot shall be unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，目标侧盲区应处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Throughout the lane-change maneuver, the target-side blind spot shall remain clear.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 整个变道过程中，目标侧盲区应始终保持无占用。
